title: On the sum of the two largest eigenvalues of the curl-curl operator on graphs
summary: The Grone--Merris conjecture, proved by Bai in~2011, states that the spectrum of the graph Laplacian $Δ_0 = -\operatorname{div}\operatorname{grad}$ is majorized by the conjugate of the vertex degree sequence. Duval and Reiner proposed a simplicial complex analogue of this statement. On a graph, where triangles serve as $2$-simplices, their conjecture reduces to the assertion that the spectrum of $\operatorname{curl}^*\operatorname{curl}$ is majorized by the conjugate of the second-order degree sequence, which records the number of triangles containing each vertex.
